relative-links-resolve.where: ! grep -oE '\]\([^)#]+' README.txt | cut -c3- | grep -v '^http' | while read -r path; do git cat-file -e "74b7410:$path" 2>/dev/null || echo "gone: $path"; done | grep gone

backtick-paths-exist.where: ! grep -oE '`(teamwork|paperwork|homework)/[^` ]+`' README.txt | tr -d '`' | while read -r path; do git cat-file -e "74b7410:$path" 2>/dev/null || echo "gone: $path"; done | grep gone

items.quote: **owner**: the person who asks the sessions for work and answers their questions
**manager**: the one Claude session per project that writes down what the owner asks for as a GitHub issue
**worker**: a Claude session that takes one issue from the manager
**sentinel**: a light Claude session that the manager starts for one endless duty
**judge**: a new Claude helper that did not write the work and only reviews it
